table_title: Table 9.9.3.4B.1: SMS services status information element
columns: SMS services status value (octet 1, bit 1 to 3)
rows: SMS services not available in this PLMN
All other values are unused and shall be treated as abnormal case, if received by the UE.
Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero.
